name: Langham Gold Coast & Jewel Residence
insider_take: Where Gold Coast glamour meets Langham's legendary luxury - this is Australia's most sophisticated beachfront escape.
whats_special: The Langham Gold Coast is the only internationally-branded luxury hotel directly on Broadbeach's pristine shoreline. As part of Langham's exclusive Couture Program, it offers bespoke experiences including private beach cabanas and personalized butler service. The property features the Southern Hemisphere's largest Chuan Spa and boasts direct access to both the beach and the renowned Pacific Fair shopping precinct.
pro_tip: Book a Jewel Residence suite for exclusive access to the private Sky Deck with panoramic ocean views - it's the Gold Coast's best-kept secret for watching the sunrise over the Pacific.
dont_miss: The hotel sits atop the $670 million Jewel development, home to Australia's largest rooftop infinity pool suspended 320 feet above sea level. Walk directly onto Broadbeach's golden sands, or stroll to the nearby SkyPoint Observation Deck - Australia's highest external building climb at Q1 Tower, just minutes away.
pros: Prime Gold Coast beachfront location with direct beach access
Luxurious Jewel Residence suites with spacious layouts and premium amenities
Signature Langham service standards and Couture Program benefits
Multiple dining venues and extensive resort facilities
cons: Large resort scale may feel less intimate
